title: Bellatrix Library
note: Wellbeing and activation for care homes. These activities are not medical treatments.

checks.label: Works by pointing from a distance; touching the screen is optional
No time pressure; Help and Stop on every screen
English, French and German, spoken and written
No patient data leaves the robot (GDPR)

packs.name: Bellatrix Basics
packs.promise: Greeting, the day, small daily choices and kind social moments.

packs.name: Memory
packs.promise: Remembering, recognising and talking about the past.

packs.name: Movement
packs.promise: Gentle seated movements, new every day.

packs.name: Music
packs.promise: Songs to recognise and music moments to enjoy.

packs.name: Board games
packs.promise: Chess and Ludo: against Bellatrix, together at one robot, or between robots.

apps.name: Bellatrix Play Premium
apps.about: Unlocks synced lyrics, the big clip view and listening without a time limit in Bellatrix Play.

apps.name: Chess
apps.tagline: Chess against Bellatrix or a friend.
apps.about: A large board, three levels and short puzzles. An unfinished game waits for next time.

apps.name: Ludo
apps.tagline: The great classic, up to six players.
apps.about: Play together at one robot or between robots. Bellatrix takes the free places.

apps.name: Conductor
apps.tagline: Conduct an orchestra with your arms.
apps.about: The resident conducts the orchestra with arm movements. The camera follows the tempo.

apps.name: Air painting
apps.tagline: Paint in the air with your hand.
apps.about: Paint with the hand in the air. The picture becomes a postcard for the family.

apps.name: Time machine
apps.tagline: Travel back to a year of your choice.
apps.about: Choose a year: pictures from the archives, songs, prices and questions from that time.

apps.name: The book of my life
apps.tagline: A memory film of a whole life.
apps.about: A memory film made from the life story and family photos.
